description: The lead events LinkedIn has PUSHED to Hermoso for this brand (new lead / deleted lead, with the form and the lead id), newest first. Empty means none have arrived, not that none exist — list_linkedin_leads reads every lead regardless, and subscribe_linkedin_leads is what starts delivery. Read a lead’s answers with get_linkedin_lead. Read-only, free.
